memory_diff_same_snapshot: Choose two different loaded snapshots before comparing classes.
memory_diff_limit: Comparison exceeds the bounded class/name budget; narrow the input or use a smaller dump.
memory_diff_query_failed: Cannot read the complete class histogram from one of the snapshots.
memory_diff_mapping_mismatch: The snapshots use different mapping identities. This comparison requires both snapshots to be unmapped or to use the same mapping.
memory_diff_invalid_identity: The snapshot source or mapping identity is invalid; no comparison was published.
memory_diff_not_published: No current A/B comparison is ready. Compare the selected snapshots before analyzing or exporting the diff.
memory_diff_ai_evidence_failed: Cannot build AI evidence for this A/B comparison: {error}
memory_diff_ready: Class-level comparison only · object IDs are local to each dump
memory_diff_unavailable: Load two HPROF snapshots to compare class counts, shallow and retained size.
